decisions.reason: The date-picker scope extension does not change multiline entry or hard-return spacing; those are separate clauses in the source message.
Applying date-picker functionality to additional templates does not change the required visual cues or empty-field visibility.
The source decision extends date functionality and does not alter the representation or architecture of ordinary text-entry fields.

Date-picker functionality and automatic placeholder clearing are independent behaviors. The same message's placeholder failure is already represented separately and does not require a propagated MODIFY from the date-picker scope change.
Extending date-picker functionality to the Board Meeting template does not change its separate Topic-adjacent row and border behavior.
The date-picker scope extension does not modify field-label text, hover access, help-text placement, or label persistence.
The source requests equivalent date-selection functionality in additional templates but does not change the Danish date placeholder or any other interface text.
The bullet-size and spacing feedback is an independent clause and is not a consequence of the date-picker scope extension.
The color-palette restriction is an independent decision in the same message and is unaffected by extending date-picker functionality.
Fixed margins in the Guidance template are independent of date-field functionality in the Indstilling and Board Meeting templates.
The date-picker scope extension does not resolve or modify legacy copy-paste layout and style behavior.
The source decision about date fields does not alter Tab-based list hierarchy or resolve its existing interaction ambiguity.
